reviews.text: They were not good, they gave my dog ​​an IV drip when he couldn't and they made him die, don't trust me
Dr. Di Leva has saved my now 13-year-old cat twice. She's professional and empathetic, but I trust her implicitly. I'll also bring her my now 13-year-old dog.

Forced to give one star...
Terrible experience

Incompetent and attached to the god of money as if there were no tomorrow... incompetent and rude staff... I strongly advise everyone against putting their animals in the hands of these unscrupulous and unloving people.
I had a very good time

My 13-year-old Chihuahua is a regular patient at the clinic for vaccinations and routine checkups.
One evening, he wasn't feeling well; he was a bit down.
I went to the clinic and Dr. Chiara examined him for a few minutes, gave him four Dolorina tablets, all for €30, and quoted a cardiology consultation, tests, ECG, and x-ray for an additional €130.
I made the appointment and showed up. Before starting, the cardiologist disagreed with the quote and told her colleague that she doesn't work for those amounts and that she would have to repay the money...
I made it clear that I wouldn't pay more than agreed upon, and we began. She diagnosed mitral insufficiency by listening to his heart with the appropriate instrument for a few seconds!
Chico, who weighs 2.2 kg, couldn't be held still by the two professionals, who ruled it impossible to proceed with the ECG or the x-ray. They asked for a new appointment, during which I don't know how they proposed to resolve the issue...
They then tried to run tests, criticizing me for not handling the dog properly and sending me away because the dog was getting too stressed, and the tests were impossible.
My legitimate suspicion is that the tests became impossible because they no longer liked the estimate. My dog ​​has undergone two surgeries, and excellent vets have always been able to perform the necessary tests, including X-rays and an EKG.
I left and will never return.
HIGHLY NOT RECOMMENDED

This time I was disappointed, in addition to the terror experienced by us family members for a diagnosis that later with the negative results proved to be unfounded, treated in day hospital the dog died

It's not even worth a star.
My dog, brought in for a supposed earache, died of two cardiac arrests, no diagnosis. It's been a while, but to this day I still can't understand how such facilities are even open. DO NOT BRING YOUR DOGS.
I feel sorry for those who work there, but it's not your business.
They're incompetent and completely unhelpful. They never answer the phone. They also take advantage of every opportunity just to get money without solving the puppy's problems.
